Package com.kristensoft.kdc

Class ClientParameters.Builder<T extends ClientParameters.Builder<T>>

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.kristensoft.kdc.Parameters.Builder<T>
      • com.kristensoft.kdc.ClientParameters.Builder<T>
  • Type Parameters:
    T - the protocol-specific builder type.
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    KristenHttpClientParameters.Builder, MulticastParameters.Builder, TcpClientParameters.Builder, UdpClientParameters.Builder
    Enclosing class:
    ClientParameters
    public abstract static class ClientParameters.Builder<T extends ClientParameters.Builder<T>>
extends Parameters.Builder<T>
    Base builder for configuring client parameters. Provides common client configuration used by protocol-specific client parameter builders.
